definition: Docking and model assessment informed by experimental or predicted interaction information, classically encoded as ambiguous interaction restraints (AIRs).
assumptions: The workspace does not provide a runnable HADDOCK3 installation or ready docking workflow
Mutagenesis-derived interface evidence from SKEMPI can be used to emulate the data-integration logic for validation-oriented analysis
invariants: Keep the analysis centered on experimentally informed interfaces rather than blind structure scoring
Use the barnase-barstar PDB as the structural reference
Use SKEMPI mutation measurements as validation evidence
non_negotiable_structural_steps: Extract interface geometry from the provided complex structure
Map mutation records onto the structure when possible
Quantify mutation impact using direct thermodynamic transformation from affinity values
State explicitly that this is not an exact HADDOCK3 docking reproduction if HADDOCK3 is absent
